title: SVAF order interface, data product code, staleness parameter and harness pack are not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 R7.2 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 16, 18, 41 and 43; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slide 17; legacy RWB-E4-001 sections 12 and 15
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: Five sets of values the story needs are given nowhere in the sources read. First, the SVAF order interface: its interface ID, its transport (REST call or file), the order-file or message layout and its test endpoint, none of which the legacy key or the architecture extract names, since S1's contract lists only 'REST Source data: collateral, appraisals' as its outbound leg. Second, the data product code that serves the v_ace_valuation appraisal row and the valuation_ext acceptance fields through GET /api/recovery/source-data/v1/data-products/{productCode}/records. Third, the parameter name that holds the 12-month appraisal staleness limit, which the Temporal and Drools extract states as a clock duration without naming a parameter, because no S1 package is in force (Phase 2). Fourth, the gateway-bff composite route that composes the reads behind SCR-13 Route decision. Fifth, the wave 3 harness pack: the SIT environment specification, the seeding set and its fixtures, and the evidence report format and retention. No source read gives any of these values, so each is written with the section R9 placeholder in the story.
evidence: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 16 (P2 owns interface config, file runs and outbound items, first API path /interface-runs), slide 18 (rwb-valuation IN: GET /cases/{id}/valuation, POST /cases/{id}/route-proposals; OUT: REST Source data: collateral, appraisals, with no SVAF interface named), slide 41 (service catalogue: no interface identifier per external system) and slide 43 (FileDelivered and FileFailed listed for rwb-integration without an interface code); Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slide 17 ('No S1 package yet (Phase 2)' and 'Appraisal stale after 12 months', with no parameter name); legacy RWB-E4-001 section 12 (one endpoint, POST /api/recovery/v1/cases/{caseId}/route) and section 15 (SCR-13 Route decision, states only).
proposed: Agree at the wave 3 entry check, with the integration and QA leads, the SVAF interface ID, its transport, the order-file layout and the test endpoint, the data product code for v_ace_valuation and valuation_ext, the parameter name for the 12-month limit, the gateway-bff composite route for SCR-13, and the wave 3 harness pack with its seeding set and evidence format.

title: The data product code, the acceptance write, the multi-appraisal choice and the wave 3 harness pack are not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 R7.2 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 15, 18, 41 and 43; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slide 17; legacy RWB-E4-002 sections 12 and 15
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: No source read gives the data product code that carries v_ace_valuation and valuation_ext, the operation that writes the acceptance fields accepted, accepted_at and accepted_by in valuation_ext against the valuation_key, which appraisal is chosen when one asset has more than one appraisal, the gateway-bff composite route that serves SCR-13 Route decision, the wave 3 harness pack with its environment, its seeding set and its evidence format and retention, or the feature flag key of the harness. The legacy key gives the business values AP-0001, AST-0001, 2026-11-02 and 4250000, the states and the screen only, Architecture v5 slides 15, 18, 41 and 43 give owners and paths without a product code or a composite route, and Temporal and Drools slide 17 gives the S1 step list without a package in force.
evidence: No source read gives these values; ownership.json gives owners, tables and operations only, and the legacy key gives the business values and the screen states only
proposed: Agree the data product code that carries v_ace_valuation and valuation_ext, the operation that writes the acceptance fields, the choice when an asset has more than one appraisal, the gateway-bff composite route for SCR-13 and the wave 3 harness pack, seeding and evidence format with the integration, data product and QA owners at the wave 3 entry check, and build against the fakes until then

title: The fee tables, the fee operation and the wave 3 harness pack are not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 R7.2 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 17, 41 and 43; legacy RWB-E4-045 sections 12 and 15
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: Four sets of values the story needs are given nowhere in the sources read. First, the fee tables and the two schedules: who owns and stores the fee tables and the court fee and charge schedules, their table and field names and their contents, and which field or child record of partner carries the contracted fee terms. Architecture v5 slide 17 puts fees inside schema rwb_payment and slide 41 puts fees inside rwb_partner, but neither names a fee table, and no source read names the schedule tables, the owner who maintains them or the court fee and charge values they hold. Second, the fee operation and its fields: the operation and the field names in rwb-payment that carry the calculated partner fee, court fee, charge and vendor fee amounts, and whether the match operation returns them or only records them. Third, the data product code that serves the v_ace_payment row through GET /api/recovery/source-data/v1/data-products/{productCode}/records. Fourth, the wave 3 harness pack: the SIT environment specification, the seeding set and its fixtures, and the evidence report format and retention. No source read gives any of these values, so each is written with the section R9 placeholder in the story.
evidence: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 17 gives rwb-payment IN: REST GET /cases/{id}/payments and POST /proceeds/{id}/allocate, TMP Act: matchPayments, confirmBookings and postProceeds, and DB writes schema rwb_payment: payment and proceeds matching, fees, bookings, posting files, with no fee table named; the same slide gives rwb-partner DB writes schema rwb_partner: panel, partner users, instructions, results, fees, scorecards, again with no fee table named. Slide 41 gives the P8 catalogue row with first API path /cases/{id}/payments and wave 2, and the S9 row with /partners and wave 4. Slide 43 row 25 gives ProceedsMatched, producer rwb-payment, topic rwb.payment.events.v1. Legacy RWB-E4-045 section 12 states Endpoints: None and section 15 gives SCR-28 with its three states, with no fee operation, fee table or schedule named. ownership.json gives owners, tables and operations only and holds no fee or schedule table. No source read gives the product code, the fee field names, the environment, the seeding set or the evidence format.
proposed: Agree who owns and stores the fee tables and the court fee and charge schedules, the operation and field names that carry the calculated fees in rwb-payment, the data product code for v_ace_payment, and the wave 3 harness pack, seeding and evidence format with the integration, data product and payment owners before the wave 3 entry check.

title: ALS interface, booking operation and wave 3 harness pack are not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 R7.2 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 16, 18, 41 and 43; legacy RWB-E4-046 sections 12 and 15
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: Five sets of values the story needs are given nowhere in the sources read. First, the ALS interface: its interface ID, its transport (REST call or file), the booking message or file layout and its result codes, and its test endpoint, none of which the legacy key or the architecture extract names, because slide 16 gives rwb-integration interface config, file runs and outbound items without an interface identifier per external system, and slide 43 lists FileDelivered and FileFailed without an interface code. Second, the operation in rwb-payment that posts a settlement booking to ALS: slide 18 gives rwb-payment the activities matchPayments, confirmBookings and postProceeds and the outbound leg deliverFile (posting file), and names no booking operation, while the legacy key says only that the work runs as a service or a scheduled job inside the recovery module with no endpoint. Third, the data product code that serves the v_ace_account booked position and the v_ace_payment settlement payment through GET /api/recovery/source-data/v1/data-products/{productCode}/records. Fourth, the outbound_item field IDs the harness reads out of DF-OPS-168 to DF-OPS-177 and the interface_config field IDs behind the ALS item, since the field list is given without a field-to-ID mapping. Fifth, the wave 3 harness pack: the SIT environment specification, the seeding set and its fixtures for account A-0001, its next ACE batch and treatment T-0001, and the evidence report format and retention. No source read gives any of these values, so each is written with the section R9 placeholder in the story.
evidence: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 16 (P2 owns interface config, file runs, outbound items; first API path /interface-runs; outbound legs are WIN daily outbound file INT-14 and debt buyer files INT-25, with no ALS interface named), slide 18 (rwb-treatment IN: GET/POST /treatments, POST /treatments/{id}/offer; OUT: TMP Payment: postProceeds, with no booking operation named), slide 41 (service catalogue: rwb-integration first API path /interface-runs, rwb-payment first API path /cases/{id}/payments, no interface identifier per external system) and slide 43 (FileDelivered and FileFailed listed for rwb-integration without an interface code); legacy RWB-E4-046 section 12 ('None. The work runs as a service or a scheduled job inside the recovery module.') and section 15 (SCR-28 Proceeds matching, states only); ownership.json gives owners of tables and operations only and carries no interface ID, product code or field mapping.
proposed: Agree at the wave 3 entry check, with the integration, payment and QA leads, the ALS interface ID, its transport, its message layout and its test endpoint, the operation in rwb-payment that posts the booking, the data product code for v_ace_account and v_ace_payment, the outbound_item and interface_config field IDs the harness reads, and the wave 3 harness pack with its environment, seeding set and evidence format.

title: The general ledger interface, the posting reference, the entry set per route and the wave 3 harness pack are not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 R7.2 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 16, 17, 41 and 44; legacy RWB-E4-047 sections 12 and 15
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: Seven sets of values the story needs are given nowhere in the sources read. First, the general ledger interface: its interface identifier, its transport (REST call or file), the posting file layout and its field list, the result codes it returns and the test endpoint, none of which Architecture v5 slide 16 or slide 41 names, because P2 is given interface config, file runs and outbound items without an interface code per external system, and slide 44 lists no posting job for the general ledger. Second, the entry set that each route posts, for the settlement on R-SET-14 and its final installment on R-SET-18, the asset sale on R-DIS-54, the debt sale posting run on R-DS-31 and the write-off on R-WO-21, which the rules state as an action and not as debits and credits. Third, the field that carries the posting reference the core system and the ledger return, and where it is held against the proceeds and against the outbound item, since the legacy key names no field and the architecture gives the outbound item without a reference column. Fourth, the data product code that serves the v_ace_payment row through GET /api/recovery/source-data/v1/data-products/{productCode}/records, which the source data contract leaves as a path variable. Fifth, the wave 3 harness pack: the SIT environment specification, the seeding set and its fixtures, the evidence report format and its retention, and the harness feature flag key. Sixth, the month-end close window that the debt sale posting waits for under R-DS-31. Seventh, the Finance provision feed input that R-DS-31 sends and its format. No source read gives any of these values, so each is written with the section R9 placeholder in the story.
evidence: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 16 (P2 owns interface config, file runs and outbound items, first API path /interface-runs, topic rwb.integration.events.v1 with FileDelivered and FileFailed, and no general ledger interface named), slide 17 (P8 rwb-payment IN: GET /cases/{id}/payments and POST /proceeds/{id}/allocate, Temporal acts matchPayments, confirmBookings and postProceeds as a saga step, OUT: TMP Integration: deliverFile (posting file), with no interface code or file layout), slide 41 (service catalogue: P2 and P8 rows give owners and paths only) and slide 44 (JOB-07 payment matching and JOB-08 booking confirmation, with no general ledger posting job and no month-end close window); Template and Rules v1 R7.2 section 12 tables and R9 placeholder; legacy RWB-E4-047 section 12 (Endpoints: None, the work runs as a service or a scheduled job inside the recovery module) and section 15 (SCR-28 Proceeds matching, states only).
proposed: Agree at the wave 3 entry check, with the integration, finance and QA leads, the general ledger interface identifier, its transport, the posting file layout and test endpoint, the entry set that each route posts, the posting reference field, the data product code for v_ace_payment, the month-end close window, the provision feed input, and the wave 3 harness pack with its seeding set and evidence format.
